subject: CAMPAIGN GOAL: the sentiment pipeline tells the truth on every surface it draws, in the order this card holds
activeForm: Working the board in priority order
description:
THE GOAL. Every surface this service draws is currently lying in a different way: the chart pins near +1.0 because fanout discards sign, its source selector renders one identical line in four modes, the frontend keeps the previous series when a mode returns empty, and the digest labels every ticker neutral because its queries throw. Above all of them sits a deploy gate that cannot fail. Work the cards until each surface shows measured data or an honest empty state, and until a broken deploy is stopped by CI rather than by a reader noticing.

UPDATE DISCIPLINE. New scope is appended here as discovered; finished items are deleted, not annotated. Cards are canon for their own content; this list is canon for ordering. On main, update this file in the same commit that adds, trims or deletes a card. On a card branch it is not yours to write: report the board change you need in your final message.

PRIORITY ORDER.
1. Card 8 (deploy gate cannot fail). Highest consequence on the board: it silently passes broken deploys and a real bug already shipped through it. Independent of card 1, shares no files with it, so it can run concurrently. Stowed with three diagnosed defects, patches exported and needing rebase.
2. Card 1 (signed-fanout). Implemented on branch 001-signed-fanout, PR #1032 open with checks green. Remaining: merge, the admin bootstrap apply for the backfill IAM role, and the backfill on separate per-environment operator go. Unblocks cards 2, 4 and 5.
3. Card 2 (source attribution always 'dedup:'). Kills the chart's source modes at the root. Blocked by card 1 only for the mixed-data story; verify the refuter confirmation before building.
4. Card 3 (chart keeps a stale series). One-line class of fix, but decide it WITH card 2: once real sources flow, empty modes get rarer and silence is still a lie.
5. Card 4 (digest never worked). Check whether digest emails currently ship to anyone before spending on it.
6. Card 5 (finance-native model swap). Research is DONE, no re-derivation owed. Quality gains are invisible until card 1 lands.
7. Card 6 (live README hero). Operator-commissioned as a battleplan with a research component. Needs card 1 landed or the hero draws the defect.
8. Card 9 (specs tree hygiene). Operator-commissioned housekeeping, 372 specs/ entries. Run it when it stops competing with feature work; it touches no runtime code.
9. Card 7 (re-add CloudWatch alarms). Blocked on deciding alarms are wanted again. The deletion was a cost call, not a verdict.

STANDING, NOT ORDERED. cards/improve-local.json is this repo's improve-local inbox: it is a dump target, never a queue position. Batch it with `improve-collect.py local` in this root checkout.

OPEN LOOSE ENDS NOT YET CARDED.
- PR #1035 (remove cloudwatch alarms) and PR #866 (fix 2 vacuous E2E tests, open since 2026-04-05) are both open and unmerged. Decide merge or close.
- specs/001-quarrysome-promotion/ is the closeout that stays open by standing operator decision until its work items land.
- Untracked spec dirs carrying real planning artifacts and no card: 001-eslint-9-flat-config, 001-makefile-compose-repair, 001-makefile-hardening, 001-makefile-stale-shortlist, 001-md-overhaul, 001-prepush-alert-visibility, 001-readme-landing, 001-secrets-wrapper-normalize. Card 9's sweep adjudicates each one.
